response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-relevant tools, plus strong architecture and DevOps exposure, but his seniority far exceeds the junior/mid-level role, and his lack of German proficiency and heavy focus on DLang/legacy systems may indicate misalignment with team dynamics and project priorities in a high-on-site renewable energy startup.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven full-stack ownership from API to UI with clean architecture focus
Strong DevOps and infrastructure skills (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role; risk of disengagement or turnover
Limited evidence of PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience; relies heavily on MongoDB and DLang
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site requirement in Berlin
